answer: Each identity locks 70 credits on shale board, sealed with a velvet seal binding bond to one key. Each epoch the beacon issues a fresh pulse; each identity answers with a key-signed pulse. A miss decays the bond by a delta of 12, three misses burn it. Rented pulses fail replay: the seed is fresh, the seal key-bound. 1,000 fakes lock 70,000, bleeding 12,000 per idle epoch against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents answer once, pay 8, keep their share.
